title: Design System: Smart Tha Pho Backup Monitor

nativeSurface.scope: Backup monitor only; excludes the four existing web applications.
nativeSurface.rendering: Application.EnableVisualStyles; AutoScaleMode.Dpi; platform-owned control chrome and interaction states.
nativeSurface.assetPolicy: No shipping raster assets. QA captures are evidence only.
nativeSurface.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS replicas or invented tonal ramps: this is an observed native surface, not a web component library.

title.purpose: The single top-level title; WinForms point units.

body.purpose: Inherited form, status, action, URL, link, and note typography; WinForms point units.

components.name: Native action button
components.description: System.Windows.Forms.Button; equal sizing with platform hover, focus, pressed, and disabled states. Stop remains enabled during startup.

components.name: Ready status
components.description: System.Windows.Forms.Label; written ready state paired with ready ink.

components.name: Error status
components.description: System.Windows.Forms.Label; explicit failure and log guidance, not color alone.

components.name: Non-ready status
components.description: System.Windows.Forms.Label; checking, stopped, and shared-service states.

components.name: Current operation
components.description: Dock-filled Label with AutoEllipsis and full-text ToolTip; error phase uses the error-state token.

components.name: Direct URL
components.description: Read-only, dock-filled System.Windows.Forms.TextBox with Thai accessible name; no custom field styling.

components.name: Utility link
components.description: Auto-sized System.Windows.Forms.LinkLabel for local website, Pages, and runtime logs; native link rendering.

narrative.overview:
The confirmed direction is a simple native Windows status window. This document captures the implemented WinForms monitor only; it does not define or change the design of the four existing web applications.

Standard Windows controls carry appearance, focus, disabled states, and window chrome. No invented metaphor, custom theme, generated artwork, or shipping raster asset is part of this surface.
keyCharacteristics: Left-aligned Thai status text with explicit state labels.
A read-only online URL and four adjacent actions.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies readable status text; it does not replace the state label.

dos: Do preserve the approved native Windows form and platform control behavior.
Do pair state colors with explicit readable labels.
Do keep stopping available during startup and expose failures through status text and logs.
donts: Don't apply these tokens or layout rules to the existing web applications.
Don't introduce a decorative theme, metaphor, or raster artwork into this monitor.
Don't hard-code platform-default control colors, corners, or focus treatments as custom styling.
